expectedResult: Metadata persists, binary persists in storage, and the same attachment appears after reload.
actualResult: The supported controlled file appeared in the generated attachment draft and Save produced an active-row/history signal, but the attachment disappeared after a fresh reload. Therefore metadata/binary persistence is not proven and the case still does not meet its expected result.
reviewBoundary: BUG-0025 still failed persistence, while the same deployed runtime has IDTS-116 controlled BUG-0019 upload/reload/download/delete proof. This narrows the finding away from a universal storage outage but does not identify whether BUG-0025 state, generated-facet lifecycle, or another scoped runtime condition caused it. DonHV must classify the candidate.

evidence.description: Safe upload failure for a supported 54-byte text file.
Fresh 2026-08-03 targeted rerun: safe upload failure and empty evidence grid for a synthetic 47-byte text file.
Current runtime shows the supported file in the generated draft attachment row.
Fresh reload shows no attachment row, proving persistence failure.

privacyReview.notes: A synthetic 54-byte text fixture only; no personal or project-secret content.

issueClassification: product defect or deployed-environment storage blocker candidate
limitations: No direct HANA/S3 diagnostic access was available; root cause cannot be assigned from UI evidence alone.

Cross-record investigation reference: docs/pm/evidence/idts-116/attachment-end-to-end-sangvn-20260804/README.md proves the same runtime succeeds on controlled BUG-0019, so this is not evidence of a universal provider outage.
